Try to discover IMAP and SMTP settings for an email account, optionally authenticating against an autodiscovery server that refuses to answer anonymously<br/><br/>Hosted Exchange answers autodiscovery only for an authenticated request, which is why this endpoint exists alongside `GET /v1/autoconfig`. The password is sent to the autodiscovery host named by the address domain's own DNS records, and only after that host has asked for it with a Basic challenge over HTTPS.
